title: Pancakes in Minecraft
description: Resource pack for pancakes in Minecraft!
body:
With this Texture Pack you can make delicious pancakes from pumpkin pie!                       
С этим Текстур Паком вы сможете из тыквенного пирога сделать очень аппетитные блины!

1. Pancake with caviar | Блинчик с икрой ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6cc51ec0bd4da735e1aabb47683c61f86609c8b.png)
2. Pancake | Блинчик ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3caee22de31781a1e67511be7aa87d47e94beb38.png)
3. Pancake with sour cream | Блинчик со сметаной ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5099e6608add3cd6c4944032d246660d5048518.png)
4. Pancake with condensed milk | Блинчик со сгущёнкой ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/002e3c3b11cf4f62faa59d07700d86886d34e4e7.png)
5. Pancake with cottage cheese | Блинчик с творогом ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c53a20c65af00ee09faf7f68d497740821fcdd3d.png)
6. Pancake with raspberries | Блинчик с малиной ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b438b209669fff24072823d0d7c98a429ff70a13.png)
7. Pancake with cherry | Блинчик с вишней ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d83b1bc61b87f0ed086c7ab519f8805459c7c08a.png)
8. Pancake with meat | Блинчик с мясом ![Pancake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f0027f5fee7c96c4daec86627f4581a0b0a7cca.png)

To get a pancake, you need to rename the **pumpkin pie** with the name above.                   
Чтобы получить блин, вам нужно переименовать **тыквенный пирог** названием выше.
